lead: Target / TGT — The checkout-line comeback finally rings up
smaller: Solana / SOL-USD — The FTX orphan becomes the altcoin rocket
Tesla / TSLA — A billion dollars of leveraged Musk faith
Palo Alto Networks / PANW — The AI security darling trips on billings
why_lead: Target combined the session's largest large-cap move (+17.75% to 130.46 USD, +18.37% over 20 sessions, against +0.16% for the S&P 500) with newly published results: an earnings beat on margin improvement and inventory drawdown despite falling sales (n1019, n1018, n1020). Attention: the CEO's locked-merchandise line (n1016), shopper-investor comparison content (n0587) and a retail-trader sentiment survey (n1895). Macro backdrop from the PPI drop and slipping retail sales (n2153, n2020); sector split from TJX and Walmart (n1014, n1013, n1012, n1045, n0246) and the shrink caveat (n1017); breaks from Walmart's pending report (n1257), falling sales, the 20-session reference and promotions (n0100). Analog is the general inventory-hangover mechanism, anchored on the WSJ's year-of-misfires framing (n0841).
why_smaller: Solana: newly published mainstream coverage that it nearly tripled in a month amid an altcoin rally (n1897), +15.30% on the day and +99.95% over 20 sessions with bitcoin +6.59%, plus Wall Street bitcoin-demand framing (n1092): late-stage altcoin FOMO; spot-ETF timing (n1108) and the 20-session reference supply the break. A brief secondary repeat justified by new evidence and a larger move.

Tesla: newly published TSLL milestone as the first billion-dollar single-stock ETF (n1899) shows leveraged retail demand; Starship flight dated in a headline (n1866, n1006) is the mood catalyst; price-war and supplier headlines (n1223, n0930) and a flat 20-session tape (+0.07%) supply the break. A leveraged founder-faith narrative, distinct from the Target and Solana stories.

Palo Alto Networks: momentum AI-security name with an 87% rally in the spotlight (n0922) and acquisitions (n0973); after-close results (released after the US close, before the cutoff) brought a billings miss and slip (n0983) against CEO demand comments (n0981), plus Nvidia's snapped streak (n1297): the momentum-winner-meets-guidance narrative.

considered_not_chosen.reason: +23.61% (the largest single-session gain) but no own-date headline explains it, so no supportable story.

selection_memory.lead_material_change: Target appeared on 2023-11-14 only as a smaller item previewing its pending report (holiday shopper takes the stand). It is promoted to lead on the newly published results and reaction (n1019, n1018, n1020, published 2023-11-15): a +17.75% move, a margin-led beat and new management comments (n1016, n1017). Solana returns as a brief secondary item only on newly published CNBC coverage (n1897) and a larger move; Tesla returns on the newly published TSLL milestone (n1899). The 2023-11-15 lead (IWM) is not repeated.
